Value.Value: This subflow help in getting the Info Message and closing this message.

First, locate the Message section and use the identified found element as the 'Source element' for the subsequent web element. This setup creates a one-to-one mapping, effectively linking them together.

Once again, we'll use the Source Element. This means that even if there are multiple messages displayed in the message bar, the close button will only be linked to the first Info message found, excluding other message types like errors or warnings.
